'''Truugo''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[44 ABY]]. [[Kitaya Shuul]] was one of his [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]], and he often sent her out to conduct espionage missions around [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].
